adjudications_received.note: verdicts this node has received() into its own log about its served exchanges -- not this node's own judgment of itself. The counterparty-held references path is what carries weight in an adversarial reading; this count is never presented as a substitute for it.

coverage.note: cross-check handle: recompute the fold from the node's ledger, check the ledger against this root, confirm the root was witnessed
